title: Knowledge Graphs & GraphRAG
tagline: Store facts as connected entities, query them with Cypher, build graphs from text with LLMs, and use them for retrieval that follows relationships.
prereqs: AI Engineering (embeddings and RAG). Graph Neural Networks helps for the embeddings step but is optional.

steps.title: What is a knowledge graph?
steps.why: Entities and relationships as a graph, and why that structure helps.

steps.title: Taxonomies, ontologies, and semantics
steps.why: The vocabulary that defines what a graph's nodes and edges mean.

steps.title: Graph databases
steps.why: A fast tour of Neo4j and the property graph model.

steps.title: Cypher basics
steps.why: Create, match, and update nodes and relationships with Cypher.

steps.title: Knowledge graph embeddings
steps.why: TransE and friends: score missing links with learned vectors.

steps.title: Extract a knowledge graph from text with an LLM
steps.why: Turn unstructured text into entities and relations using GPT-4o.

steps.title: GraphRAG vs. vector RAG
steps.why: Where retrieving connected facts beats retrieving similar chunks.

steps.title: How GraphRAG works
steps.why: Entity graphs, traversal, and multi-hop retrieval, and when you need them.

steps.title: Retrieval with Cypher queries
steps.why: An LLM writes Cypher to answer questions from a graph database.

steps.title: Build a GraphRAG pipeline
steps.why: Ontology, extraction prompts, and graph retrieval in one Python project.

steps.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
steps.why: Microsoft's community summaries for whole-corpus questions, and the indexing cost.

steps.title: LightRAG
steps.why: A cheaper graph index with dual-level retrieval.

steps.title: GraphRAG with Neo4j in practice
steps.why: A workshop combining vector search and a graph for an agent.

projects: Extract a knowledge graph from 20 Wikipedia articles with an LLM, load it into Neo4j, and answer five multi-hop questions with Cypher.
Build plain vector RAG and GraphRAG over the same documents and compare their answers on 10 questions that need connected facts.
Index a small corpus with LightRAG and write up its indexing cost, speed, and answer quality next to Microsoft GraphRAG.
